/-- [effect27::{impl effect27::EffectDigest32<effect27::CoinState<R>> for effect27::CoinOracle}::digest]:
    Source: 'src/lib.rs', lines 51:4-60:5
    Visibility: public -/
def CoinOracle.Insts.Effect27EffectDigest32CoinState.digest
  {R : Type} (RecordingInst : Recording R) (state : CoinState R)
  (parts : Slice (Slice Std.U8)) :
  Result ((Array Std.U8 32#usize) × (CoinState R))
  := do
  let i := alloc.vec.Vec.len state.coins
  let answer ←
    if state.next < i
    then
      alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice (Array Std.U8
        32#usize)) state.coins state.next
    else ok (Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8)
  let i1 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add state.next 1#usize)
  let (o, o1) := core.option.Option.take state.«record»
  match o with
  | none => ok (answer, { state with next := i1, «record» := o1 })
  | some table =>
    let (previous, table1) ← RecordingInst.insert table parts answer
    match previous with
    | none =>
      ok (answer, { state with next := i1, «record» := (some table1) })
    | some old =>
      let b ← different old answer
      if b
      then
        ok (answer,
          {
            state
              with
              next := i1, «record» := (some table1), collision := true
          })
      else ok (answer, { state with next := i1, «record» := (some table1) })

def CoinOracle.Insts.Effect27EffectDigest32CoinState {R : Type} (RecordingInst
